title: Chart quiz #3
caption:
Chart quiz #3. How many can you get right?

Q1: Uptrend, downtrend or range?
Q2: Gap fill, or gap and go?
Q3: Where does the take-profit go?

Each chart pauses so you can comment your answer, then plays on to show what happened, and why.

Tell me your score: 0, 1, 2 or 3?

Practise reading charts at memestreet.net

Fictional market. Not investment advice.

#MemeStreet #ChartQuiz #Trend #Earnings #LearnToTrade
narration: Three charts. Three new skills to test. Trends, gaps and targets. Question one. It's choppy, with some deep pullbacks. Is this an uptrend, a downtrend, or a range? An uptrend. Follow the swings, not the noise. Each high is higher than the last, and so is each low. Question two. Earnings came out, and the stock gapped up. Will the gap fill, or will it gap and go? It filled. Volume faded after the open, and long upper wicks showed sellers waiting above. Gaps on strong, rising volume are more likely to keep going. Question three. You bought near the bottom of the range. Where does your take-profit go? A, B, or C? A, just below the old resistance. C cuts a good trade short, and B sits beyond a level that's turned price away before, so it may never fill. How many did you get? Tell me your score in the comments. Practise on real charts from the game, at memestreet.net.
